name: CardStatus
meaning: status codes returned by the card layer (PC stubs keep the PS1 values)

name: CARD_STATUS_NONE
meaning: Card_StateMachine: w.status != 0 tests for any status (inferred)

name: CARD_SLOT_FULL
meaning: 'F': Card_CommitBlock with overwrite=0 on a full slot

name: CARD_UNFORMATTED
meaning: leads to FORMAT_Q (INFERRED from the flow; never returned on PC)

name: CARD_DAMAGED
meaning: leads to DAMAGED (INFERRED; never returned on PC)

name: CARD_NONE
meaning: leads to NO_CARD / LOAD_FAILED (INFERRED; never returned on PC)

name: CARD_PREWRITE_OK
meaning: CardStub_Status3, required before writing over an existing image
